chapter: Lincoln Park and the name Kid
title: Starting at Lincoln Park in 1908 after Robichaux
summary: Ory followed Robichaux at the pavilion in summer 1908 and declined his offer.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: So when did you start at Lincoln Park?
Oh, let me see... After Bolden?
Summer of 1908. Oh, yeah, Bolden. Bolden was gone then.
But he was gone then? Yeah. Was Robichaux still playing there? I followed Robichaux in there. Oh, you followed Robichaux? Yeah. In the pavilion?

Then after, and I'd taken all Robichaux away, called the Yacht Club and the Country Club, up and down St. Charles Trees, the gymnasium. Then he'd come and say, young man, you play a nice horn. He'd say, I'd like you to work with me. I said, thank you, Mr. Robichaux, I'm doing all right. Called him Mr. Robichaux.
